correctness.rationale: The encoder E(u)=(u,uP) gives, for a nonempty message support T, the exact weight |T|+wt(sum_{i in T}h_i). Data distance at least three and message-parity separation at least four are therefore equivalent to distinct nonzero check columns h_i with wt(h_i)>=3 and no zero sum of three distinct columns. For r>=5, the Davydov--Tombak structural bound for non-hyperplane sum-free subsets (5*2^(r-4)) lies strictly below M_r=2^(r-1)-r. Thus a maximizer must lie in an affine hyperplane, and counting the s weight-one and s(r-s) weight-two exclusions in {a·v=1} gives at most 2^(r-1)-s(r-s+1), with equality only at wt(a)=1 or r. A through-origin hyperplane holds at most 2^(r-2) sum-free elements. This proves the exact K(r) profile and all r+1 large-r extremizers; r<=4 is checked directly. Strict codeword-distance-three versus full-distance-four distinctions follow from explicit two-column differences. Fresh exhaustive independent set enumeration for r=3,4,5 found K=1,5,11 with 1,1,6 maximizers and inspected constructions r=5,6,7. The finite enumeration is corroboration, not the proof for all r.
